rig_source: original 240-frame Courier and Paper Artist, joint=head; no edit to d paths, pivots, expressions, body proportions or camera angles
topology: existing RISO25 source geometry preserved byte-for-byte; tonal master changes only the dot radius/count inside named facial planes

printable_material.independent_control: original screenDensity knob multiplies individual source tone; dotGain only modifies actual ink dot radius

five_axes.connectivity: same outlines, no added or removed SVG part IDs; facial tone paths keep original root parent and transform
five_axes.vector_flow: no shape edits, cheek/jaw/eye source tangents unchanged; only pressure/coverage per master
five_axes.stroke_weight: inserts light and mid physical print dot geometries, normal remains original; solid eyelid and mouth engravings remain opaque
five_axes.rhythm: pattern site locations/rotation remain identical for given plate and seed so no crawling or irregular timing; coverage differs by cell dot radius or FM site rank
five_axes.microtexture: native stencil dot areas, paper pore/edge grain, separate two-color registration remain intact

artcraft_release_gate.reason: requires actual RISO26 screenshots, independent inspected source-matched style crops; a human anatomy v9 landmark mask source is unavailable

source_rights: Original code-character geometry; external prints are not redistributed.
